description: Overcomplete top-k sparse dictionary over the v13 DomainNet corpus. Stage 1 of the breakthrough arm.

partition.comment: Held-out rows guard the overcomplete fit in place of the M78 samples-per-fitted-dimension floor, which is defined for per-class bases and does not transfer to a jointly fitted dictionary.

controls.comment: The random dictionary is the positive control for reconstruction and probe accuracy: a trained dictionary that fails to beat random unit-norm atoms has learned nothing. The shuffled-label entropy is the positive control for atom purity and must return approximately log2(128) = 7.0 bits.

gate.comment: Registered at RESEARCH_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v13.md Section 7. Advance if a cell reaches within 3.0 points of the raw-feature probe at mean active atoms <= 64. Otherwise sweep once, then close the arm.

threading.comment: Measured: at 8 threads the dictionary fit is not bit-reproducible; at 1 thread it is. Gated evidence therefore requires single-threaded workers.
